name: Pharaoh
description: Pharaoh living at the time of Divided Monarchy

points: The record names the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh and other households, and the names in this stretch carry meaning, as Jekuthiel was noted to point to the hope of the congregation of God.
